place_text: St Vincent and the Grenadines, Caribbean

plain: In 2025, according to the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, his group was running DMTX, a way of keeping people in the state brought on by the powerful psychedelic DMT for longer, and was building a retreat and research center in the Caribbean nation of St Vincent and the Grenadines. Gallimore describes it as a project he is part of, and he mentions a group called New Nautics in connection with it.
